what: THE ROUND'S HEADLINE LIGHT-BUDGET ABLATION, RECOMPUTED ON MY OWN CODE FROM ITS OWN PNGs. The sealed-crop figures the status file LEADS WITH are in NONE of the round's twelve banked metric files — those carry `full` only, and the crop numbers live in `reports/`, which HAZARDS §9 says never reaches the remote. Recomputed here while those PNGs still exist, so the round's headline is reproducible off this box. It was not before.
metric: mean |delta| rgb against the arm's own `base`, sealed judged crop [300,150,512,512] and full frame
verdict: EVERY FIGURE REPRODUCES EXACTLY. BEFORE arm, sealed crop: key_off 26.3266, env_off 8.1013, hemi_off 2.1774, fill_off 2.0384, noise floor (base_recheck) 1.8557 — the round's five numbers to four decimals. The FULL FRAME, which is what is actually banked, says it harder: hemi_off 2.5208 and fill_off 2.4074 against a floor of 2.5028, i.e. AT OR BELOW it. THE MEASUREMENT IS SOUND. What does not follow from it is the round's sentence — see light-census-visible-vs-scenewide.json: the hemisphere it switched off is 0.37107 in the frame, not 5.0011, and `unresolvable at 0.371` is not `not a lever` (at 4x the same two lights are worth +1.52 deg).
